_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "folders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "trashed_at" INTEGER NULL, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "manifest_extra" TEXT NULL, "starred" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("starred" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drive_files" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "folder_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "part_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "parts_present" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "starred" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("starred" IN (0, 1)), "minithumbnail" TEXT NULL, "thumbnail_file_id" INTEGER NULL, "taken_at" INTEGER NULL, "trashed_at" INTEGER NULL, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "manifest_extra" TEXT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "replaced_by" TEXT NULL, "adopted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("adopted" IN (0, 1)), "original_size" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file_parts" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "part_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "message_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "td_file_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id", "part_index"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transfers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "folder_id" TEXT NULL, "source_path" TEXT NULL, "owns_source" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("owns_source" IN (0, 1)), "result_path" TEXT NULL, "total_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "done_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "part_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "completed_parts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "asset_id" TEXT NULL, "taken_at" INTEGER NULL, "thumbnail_path" TEXT NULL, "save_to" TEXT NULL, "save_folder" TEXT NULL, "wifi_only" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("wifi_only" IN (0, 1)), "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "replaces_file_id" TEXT NULL, "source_chat_id" INTEGER NULL, "source_message_id" INTEGER NULL, "album_ids" TEXT NULL, "starred" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("starred" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_assets" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NULL, "failures" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "albums" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "album_files" ("album_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("album_id", "file_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "offline_pins" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_folder" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_folder" IN (0, 1)), "pinned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "offline_copies" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file_contents" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "indexed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file_opens" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "play_positions" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watched_folders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tree_uri" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination_id" TEXT NULL, "filter" TEXT NOT NULL, "subfolders" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("subfolders" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checked_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watched_files" ("rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NULL, "transfer_id" TEXT NULL, "failures" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("rule_id", "document_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_edits" ("target" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "patch" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("target", "item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "takeout_parts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "uri" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "read_at" INTEGER NULL, "problem" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "takeout_entries" ("part_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" INTEGER NOT NULL, "crc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "compressed_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "header_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("part_id", "path"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "takeout_details" ("part_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "album" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("album" IN (0, 1)), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" INTEGER NULL, "favorited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorited" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("part_id", "path"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "takeout_items" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NULL, "transfer_id" TEXT NULL, "failures" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reason" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "albums" TEXT NULL, "starred" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("starred" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
